# Valdosta Daily Times

> Local news organization serving Valdosta and South Georgia with comprehensive coverage of community, politics, crime, and regional events.

Valdosta Daily Times is the primary news source for Valdosta, Georgia and surrounding communities. The organization operates multiple platforms including digital editions, classifieds, job listings, and obituaries to serve local readers and businesses.

## Key Topics

- Valdosta, Georgia
- Local News
- Local Government
- Crime & Justice
- Classifieds & Marketplace
- Job Search
- Community Stories
- Georgia Politics
- Healthcare & Awards
- Entertainment Events
- Public Notices
- Subscriptions
- Digital Edition
- Obituaries
- Community Contests

## Core Services & Access

- [Homepage](https://valdostadailytimes.com): Main entry point for Valdosta Daily Times local news and content
- [Subscriptions](https://valdostadailytimes.com/subscriptions): Digital and print subscription plans for newspaper access
- [Digital Edition](https://digital.valdostadailytimes.com): Online e-edition and archive of Valdosta Daily Times newspaper
- [Newsletter Signup](https://valdostadailytimes.com/newsletter-signup-2): Email newsletter subscription for daily news digest delivery

## Community Marketplace & Employment

- [Classifieds Marketplace](https://marketplace.valdostadailytimes.com): Classifieds for jobs, real estate, and local business listings
- [Job Search](https://jobs.valdostadailytimes.com): Employment listings and job search engine for Valdosta area positions

## Obituaries & Memorials

- [Obituaries](https://obituaries.valdostadailytimes.com): Obituaries and memorial space for Valdosta community members
- [Coody Stood Tall in Life](https://valdostadailytimes.com/2026/03/20/coody-stood-tall-in-life): Obituary and life story of community volunteer Jeanette Coody

## Community Engagement & Contests

- [Contests](https://valdostadailytimes.com/contests): Community contests and reader engagement hub
- [Best of Contest](https://valdostadailytimes.com/best): Best of local business and community voting contest
